title: Sunscreen filter octocrylene is a potential obesogen by acting as a PPARgamma partial agonist.
authors: Ko, Hyejin; An, Seungchan; Ahn, Sungjin; Park, In Guk; Gong, Junpyo; Hwang, Seok Young; Oh, Soyeon; Ki, Min Won; Jin, Sun Hee; Choi, Won Jun; Noh, Minsoo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究防晒剂奥克立林作为PPARγ部分激动剂的致肥胖效应，涉及小分子-蛋白结合与分子对接，但对象为小分子-核受体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法仅含分子对接且无TF-DNA结合建模，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Octocrylene (OC) is an extensively prescribed organic ultraviolet B filter used in sunscreen products. Due to its extensive use, a significant level of OC is detected in marine and freshwater environments. Notably, the bioaccumulation of OC in aquatic biota may affect human health. In this study, the effect of OC on metabolism was investigated using the adipogenesis model of human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (hBM-MSCs). OC promoted adiponectin production during adipogenesis in hBM-MSCs compared to the vehicle-treated control (EC(50), 29.6 muM). In target identification, OC directly bound to peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) gamma (Ki, 37.8 muM). OC-bound PPARgamma also significantly recruited nuclear receptor coactivator proteins SRC-1 (EC(50), 54.1 muM) and SRC-2 (EC(50), 58.6 muM). In the molecular docking simulation study, the optimal ligand-binding mode of OC suggested that OC is a PPARgamma partial agonist. A competitive analysis with a PPARgamma full agonist pioglitazone revealed that OC acted as a PPARgamma partial agonist. OC altered the gene transcription profile of lipid-metabolism associated enzymes in normal human keratinocytes, primarily exposed human cells after the application of sunscreens. In conclusion, OC is a potential metabolic disrupting obesogen.
abstract_zh: 奥克立林（Octocrylene, OC）是一种广泛使用的有机紫外线B滤光剂，常用于防晒产品中。由于其广泛使用，在海洋和淡水环境中检测到显著水平的OC。值得注意的是，OC在水生生物中的生物累积可能影响人类健康。本研究利用人骨髓间充质干细胞（hBM-MSCs）的脂肪生成模型，探讨了OC对代谢的影响。与载体处理的对照组相比，OC在hBM-MSCs的脂肪生成过程中促进了脂联素的产生（EC(50)，29.6 μM）。在靶点识别中，OC直接结合过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARγ）（Ki，37.8 μM）。OC结合的PPARγ还显著招募了核受体共激活蛋白SRC-1（EC(50)，54.1 μM）和SRC-2（EC(50)，58.6 μM）。在分子对接模拟研究中，OC的最佳配体结合模式表明OC是PPARγ的部分激动剂。与PPARγ完全激动剂吡格列酮的竞争性分析显示，OC作为PPARγ部分激动剂发挥作用。OC改变了正常人类角质形成细胞中脂质代谢相关酶的基因转录谱，这些细胞是防晒霜使用后主要暴露的人类细胞。总之，OC是一种潜在的代谢干扰性致肥胖因子。
